_note: The SyncEstate VSL script. One entry per spoken phrase, in order. 'name' keys the timeline (and vo_split.py --names); 'gap' is the pause after the phrase in the synthetic (no-voiceover) timeline, longer where the picture changes scene. Keep 'text' identical to the ElevenLabs prompt so a real voiceover lines up.

phrases.name: hook
phrases.text: If your agency still runs on WhatsApp, Excel and a notebook, this is for you.

phrases.name: pain1
phrases.text: Leads get lost in chat threads.

phrases.name: pain2
phrases.text: Rent hides in a spreadsheet called final, version seven.

phrases.name: pain3
phrases.text: Signed mandates get buried in email, and commission gets worked out on a calculator.

phrases.name: agitate1
phrases.text: It's not your team. It's the tools.

phrases.name: agitate2
phrases.text: Five apps that don't talk to each other, and every gap is a deal that slips, a payment that hides, or a dispute waiting to start.

phrases.name: reveal
phrases.text: Meet Sync Estate. One app that runs your whole agency, from the phone in your pocket.

phrases.name: hub
phrases.text: One login. The Hub shows everything that needs you today: unworked leads, repair requests, overdue rent, and payouts waiting for approval.

phrases.name: crm
phrases.text: Sync C R M scores every enquiry from cold to on fire, so your agents always know who to call next.

phrases.name: viewings
phrases.text: Viewing forms are signed on the phone and locked, so nobody argues over who found the buyer.

phrases.name: stay
phrases.text: Sync Stay digitises property management. Repairs with photos, room-by-room inspections, and rent and arrears that look after themselves.

phrases.name: worth
phrases.text: Sync Worth gets valuations out the door on time, signed and locked.

phrases.name: finance
phrases.text: Sync Finance keeps trust money ready for audit, with two-person payout approval. And U S dollars and Zig never mix.

phrases.name: dev
phrases.text: With Sync Dev, you'll never double-sell a stand again.

phrases.name: media
phrases.text: And Sync Media turns a listing into an Instagram story in a few taps.

phrases.name: zim
phrases.text: It's built in Zimbabwe, for how Zimbabwe does property.

phrases.name: modules
phrases.text: Switch on only the modules you need. Start with one, and add the rest when you're ready.

phrases.name: how
phrases.text: And we don't just hand you software. LayerSync sets it up with you, brings your data across, and gets your team working in it.

phrases.name: payoff
phrases.text: Your competitors are still in five tabs. You don't have to be.

phrases.name: cta
phrases.text: Tap Get in touch, leave your name and number, and we'll pick it up with you on WhatsApp.
